source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 13
statement: An instance's status, its resident documents and a shadow report are ignorable with must-understand (SNP-27, SNP-28).
guards: compat:RecordCompatTest#each version reads and writes back the record the other wrote, unchanged
compat:RecordCompatTest#a later member without crit is dropped by a rewrite, which leaves the same record
compat:RecordCompatTest#a record whose crit names a member a version does not know is refused by it
